kernel_binding.lean_original: Existing unchanged Kernels._add_kernel directly lowered via lowerBody; original_ast_lowering proves extraction

kernel_binding.numeric_scalar_reuse: All189 raw frontend arithmetic/conversion/store fingerprints identical to reviewed vector scalar paths after only SSA/location/block-extent normalization. Existing B1024 grid/host execution is not used.

outcomes.rank_zero_error: Allocation succeeds, sizeZero event raises; no block/grid/launch.
outcomes.prepare_error: After size/block/grid/launch event. Ordinary JIT current-device/stream/binder preparation fails before frontend.
outcomes.signature_rejected: Frozen matrix64 signatures reject at first A/B unsupported fnuz argument after prepare.
outcomes.addition_rejected: 36 canonical fp8+integer/bool pairs reject addition after accepted signature.
outcomes.native_setup_error: For189 admitted frontend routes, ordinary target lowering/load/argument/launch setup can fail; its reason is retained. No kernel value or memory-result callback.
outcomes.successful_zero_grid: Actual allocator output storage/data-pointer binding and empty_like stride query are retained in FullSuccess returned metadata. These are ordinary metadata equalities, not access validity. No scalar/memory operation, no ValueDomain, pointer/alignment/permission/CUDA/owning-device premise. Actual native preparation/setup still required; CPU null pointer may be accepted by native extractPointer.
outcomes.successful_positive_grid: SafeAPI physical view metadata and finite indices; permissions in current launch device address space; concrete typed ValueDomain for active inputs/conversions; output fresh and storage-disjoint from both inputs.

extent_and_tail.size: first output shape dimension; not numel
extent_and_tail.shape_m_0_positive_m: positive first dimension with zero allocation: outside defined physical access domain; no fabricated safe result/native rollback
extent_and_tail.higher_rank: Only first size flat storage cells written. Tail is arbitrary empty_like contents, proved unchanged. e.g.[3,7] writes3 of21 cells, not21 elementwise sums.
extent_and_tail.strides: Original source ignores logical strides; actual flat storageOffset/data_ptr spans used for all three tensors. c retains actual empty_like preserve-format strides.
extent_and_tail.b_short: b.numel is unrestricted when underlying readable backing span covers size.

physical_contract.metadata: AllocationContract and FullSuccess bind actual returned output storage base/extent, dataPointer and empty_like preserve-format strides universally, including zero grids. Positive SafeAPI also binds input/output views, storageOffset and shape/product metadata. GPU owning device tags are bound when present; CPU views do not invent a GPU owner.
physical_contract.widths: 1,2,4,8 bytes per canonical dtype, bool raw byte normalization/store path preserved
physical_contract.indices: 0<size<2^31, B16, all launched pid*16+lane nonnegative signed_i32; sign-extension and unsigned64 scaled pointers agree with actual addresses
physical_contract.masked_tail: All launched pointer expressions no-wrap through rounded16 endpoint; only active bytes must fit allocations and readable/writable permissions
physical_contract.alignment: Natural element width for ordinary typed load/store primitive ABI
physical_contract.current_device: ops.launchDevice=context.currentDevice for positive launches. Permissions express actual current-address-space accessibility, including valid peer/mapped memory; no source isCUDA or same-device assertion.
physical_contract.aliasing: a and b may overlap arbitrarily. Fresh c backing allocation disjoint from both.
physical_contract.frames: Allocation preserves existing bytes outside fresh actual allocation. Kernel preserves every byte outside c active prefix, every output cell i>=size, and all input reads.
physical_contract.schedule: Any complete active-lane schedule, including repeated writes of same initial-memory result, has same final observed active output; source interpreter also executes exact tile load-before-store order.

value_domain.shared: Tagged integer/raw bool byte and finite-width floating input representation; all defined IEEE encodings including nonfinite accepted where operation/store is defined.
value_domain.mixed_float_integer: Out-of-range/NaN-to-integer output conversions excluded by existing OutputDefined, and independent specifiedCell removes undefined policies. This is structural applicability, never a numerical deferral.
value_domain.wide: 29 concrete fp64 routes,20 floating outputs and9 integer/bool outputs. Ready carries exact input types and OutputDefined for wide output conversion; no undefined result supplied.

numeric_deferral: Only308 exact scalar operations,616 positive one/multiple-block case bindings in43 families; errors, rank0 and zero-grid have no numerical obligations. No compiler/allocator/MMU/scheduler implementation proof required; no structural omission deferred.
